research_notes: Reviewed official occupations and historical Handbook, first speech, government biography, contemporary business register, winery site, REST annual report and trustee filing, plus reliable secondary first-full-time-job and label-transfer evidence.

Complete initial occupation list preserved, including early postal, council and hospitality work. Those unresolved employers cannot be assigned public/private totals from job labels. Uncle-operated kiosk is distinguished from public park.

Follow-up: kiosk legal/payroll identity and dates/hours; postal employer; council and waiter employers and short intervals; union hours/leave and federal presidency; REST appointment date and historical pay; vineyard business work hours, breaks and ownership/label transition.

Farrell Wines label/business-name continuity differs from official 2014–2016 occupation entry. ABN activation, GST dates and trading-name changes are not evidence of employment start/end or full-time status.
Initial first-speech URL returned 400 Timeout fetching; adjacent debate URL supplied full speech. Namesake US accountant/business profiles excluded. No outreach.

Follow-up2026-10-02 adds1982Manila ACTU training assignment within SDA period from reliable secondary biography. Primary ACTU course/secondment records remain a specific lead. No additional duration or employer inferred.

Targeted early mail/council/waiter employers, REST appointment, SDA national presidency and vineyard full-time searches found no usable new endpoints or hours; US historian, theatre and fuel-industry namesakes excluded. FWC2005annual-return web reader was inaccessible; this is a source gap, not a job-wide failure. Retain all prior gaps and null totals. Ordinary PDF download also returned TimeoutError: The read operation timed out.

Follow-up2026-10-03: SDA national financial report says replacement REST director GeoffWilliams became effective24July2008, while REST's own report gives Farrell resignation1July2008. These can describe vacancy and replacement rather than conflicting service endpoints; preserve the primary REST resignation date and record the23-day board-seat transition gap. No appointment-start, personal pay or substantive-hours evidence found.

Follow-up2026-10-04: REST director-appointment and uncle-operated kiosk searches again located the existing resignation report and early-work account, but no appointment start, legal kiosk entity or personal hours. A 2024 AKBC conference speaker biography describes Harvard Business School Advanced Management Program, whereas his own 3September2008 first speech identifies Kennedy School of Government study. Preserve the first-person Kennedy School evidence; do not substitute the conference description or infer a second course, dates or union leave without corroboration. Searches also returned unrelated Harvard academics and another speaker’s UN work; those are not Farrell employment. Early postal/council/waiter identities, union breaks, trustee commencement and vineyard work allocation remain unresolved.

Follow-up2026-10-05: expanded primary SDA2007/2009accounts resolve national-executive1994–2008 and national-presidency1995–20November2008; presidency continued after Senate entry. Personal national-office salary/fees$5,000 each2006/2007 established without full-time inference or attribution to branch salary. Own2011/2017Hansard supplies1984HarvardTUCP/Kennedy School study, addressing prior course-name discrepancy; course bounds and union leave still unknown. Early postal/council/waiter employer and REST-start searches returned occupation lists/namesakes, no new endpoints; Manila ACTU source still lacks primary secondment/payroll. Vineyard personal hours remain unresolved, totals null.
